text: Disputed: whether F-0116's recurring "NO STORIES" condition is a spec defect curable by SPEC-AMEND — tried 3 sessions' worth and still open. It is not. docs/specs/f-0116.md's frontmatter Stories (S-38250..S-38253) were written against the BACKLOG_ID_RANGE the spec session was given, which is the only legitimate id source; nothing in the spec is wrong. Verified in this checkout: asf/record/plan_tasks.py:34 and asf/record/replan.py:171 both still read `STORY_ID_RE = re.compile(r'\bS-\d{4}\b')` — a strict 4-digit pattern — while `ls ~/.ASF/state/asf/record/stories/` holds only S-0001..S-0004 at four digits and 95 entries from S-51600 up at five; B-0273 ("Item ids with 5+ digits never match…", merged at 013df8393, already an ancestor of this branch's HEAD) explicitly scoped its fix to "every record parser (plan_tasks, stories:, links, evidence, match)" and did widen idcheck.py, match.py and evidence.py to `\d{4,}`, but never touched these two lines — so a 5-digit Story id can never attach to a Task no matter how many times the spec is amended, whether the ids are renumbered or real Story cards are minted for them. B-0173 ("record error: story … has no Task listing it in stories:", state New, decided, S3, count 3) already tracks this exact symptom class system-wide. What now holds: no further SPEC-AMEND session should be dispatched against F-0116 for this reason — it cannot succeed by construction, and the loop ends here. What changes: F-0116's Tasks proceed to coding with `stories: []`, which is cosmetic (Feature/Task state and gating do not depend on it, confirmed by evidence: and stage: on the Feature card); the open question is reclassified from "this card's defect" to "wait on the record tooling," recorded via blocked_on. Separately noted but not part of this ruling's mechanism: T-0724 (the one surviving open Task, carrying the correct union of the replan's two Tasks' writes: per docs/plans/replans/f-0116-8266efca4547.md) has a stale, truncated Description body that stops mid-sentence and never reaches RD3's asf/hermetic.py fix or any of the check's content — a coder session should be briefed from the replan file directly, not from the Task's own body.
